== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Rycar Ryjerd (V) (Errata)]] (<code>1210_136</code>), showing the '''PC-E1''' text. No published image prints this version, so it was re-rendered in CardMaker (Batch B41b, Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026).

* '''Text source:''' the PC website card list (2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11), icons written out as the list has them.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on table. If your character is about to be lost from table, place all devices and Effects on that character in owner's Used Pile. Twice per game, may ▲ a device (or an Effect) that deploys on a character. (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 74). Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Read by eye after rendering.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
